name: Bulk Number Activity
description: Let the next follow-up start with an activity signal. Find recent activity across a full number list, separate dormant records from numbers worth reviewing, and use the result to plan reactivation, segmentation and outreach priorities.

result_fields.name: number
result_fields.description: The original submitted E.164 number, used to map this result back to a list, customer or lead record. It does not include activity time, frequency or interaction details.

result_fields.name: activated
result_fields.description: Whether an available activity signal was returned. Use it to support reactivation ordering and audience segmentation; it is not an active-day count, frequency or specific observation time.
